name: Spirit Pill
description: Ancient Qi recovery pill.
detailedDescription: A fundamental pill for any cultivator. It contains a small amount of spiritual essence to jumpstart Qi circulation.

name: Healing Pill
description: Restores 40 Health Points.
detailedDescription: Crafted from medicinal herbs, this pill accelerates the body's natural healing process. Essential for survival in harsh realms.

name: Grand Spirit Pill
description: Refined pill. Permanently increases Max Qi and restores vast amounts.

name: Vitality Pill
description: Rare medicine. Permanently increases Max HP.

name: Rusty Hammer
description: A heavy crafting tool.
detailedDescription: An old, heavy hammer once used by a master blacksmith. It remains remarkably sturdy and is essential for basic crafting.

name: Iron Ore
description: Raw material for forging.
detailedDescription: A chunk of dense iron ore. While common, its high spiritual conductivity makes it a staple in low-level artifact forging.

name: Flying Sword
description: A basic spiritual sword.
detailedDescription: A standard-issue sword for disciples. It can be psychically controlled to strike enemies from a distance, provided the wielder has sufficient Qi.

name: Fireball Staff
description: Hurl spheres of fire.

name: Divine Eyes
description: A beam of concentrated spiritual energy.

name: Triple Fireball Staff
description: Fires three fireballs in a fan pattern.

name: Spirit Burst Sword
description: Unleashes a rapid sequence of flying swords.

name: Spiritual Aura
description: Creates a protective zone of spiritual energy.

name: Realm Token
description: Required to transition between realms.

name: Improved Qi Sword
description: A sword infused with concentrated Qi.

name: Flame Sword
description: A blade that burns with spiritual fire.

name: Fire Essence
description: Concentrated heat from a spirit vein.

name: Heavenly Flame Sword
description: A mythical blade forged in celestial fire.

name: Foundation Establishment Pill
description: Required for a solid Foundation breakthrough.
detailedDescription: A Tier 2 pill containing dense spiritual energy. It stabilizes the meridians, allowing the cultivator's Qi to condense into a liquid foundation without dissipating.

name: Core Formation Pill
description: Assists in condensing the Golden Core.
detailedDescription: A rare Tier 3 pill that aids in the compression of liquid Qi into a solid Golden Core. Without it, the Core might shatter during formation, leading to severe cultivation regression.

name: Nascent Soul Pill
description: Essential for birthing the Nascent Soul.
detailedDescription: A legendary Tier 4 pill. It nourishes the spiritual mind and provides the vast energy burst required to shatter the Golden Core and birth the Immortal Nascent Soul.

name: Divine Transformation Pill
description: Cross the threshold into the Spirit Realm.
detailedDescription: A Tier 5 pill that facilitates the fusion of the primordial spirit with the heavens. It is the final required catalyst for mortals attempting to touch the Dao.

name: Manual: Fiery Palm
description: Technique: A burst of solar Qi.
detailedDescription: An ancient scorched scroll describing the circulation of Qi through the palm to ignite the surrounding essence. High damage, moderate cost.

name: Manual: Void Sword
description: Technique: A slash through dimensions.
detailedDescription: A cold, translucent manual. It teaches the cultivator how to project their will into a blade of pure void energy.

name: Manual: Thunder Clap
description: Technique: Flash like lightning.
detailedDescription: The pages of this book crackle with static electricity. It contains the fundamental mantras for the Thunder Clap movement and attack.
